notes: Sermon extract. Bible Characters (1902) is a multi-author compilation; the Moody section is headed 'Bible Characters described in his soul-winning sermons', and the editor's introduction says he 'culled from their utterances choice selections'. Several pieces are only a page long. No text is stated. Opening words: “In this first parable we are told that men ought to pray always and everywhere; that prayer should not be left to a few in the churches, but all men …”
